title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 39
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 39: the fall of Gog on the mountains of Israel, the burning of the weapons and the burial in the valley.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will strike out of Gog's left hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will strike Gog's bow out of his left hand and cause his arrows to fall out of his right hand.

questions.text: To whom will Gog and his hordes be given to be devoured?
questions.explanation: Gog will fall on the mountains of Israel, and Yahweh will give him to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

answers.text: The fish of the sea and the rivers
The people of Israel, as their slaves
The ravenous birds and the animals of the field
The merchants of Tarshish and Dedan

questions.text: On what will Yahweh send a fire?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands.

answers.text: On Mount Seir and on all of Edom
On Magog and those who dwell in the islands
On the land of Egypt and on Cush
On the city of Jerusalem and Judah

questions.text: For how long will those who dwell in the cities of Israel make fires of the weapons?
questions.explanation: Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will burn the shields, bows, arrows, war clubs and spears, and make fires with them for seven years.

questions.text: Why will they take no wood out of the field or cut any out of the forests?
questions.explanation: They will take no wood out of the field and cut none out of the forests, because they will make their fires with the weapons.

answers.text: Because they make their fires with the weapons
Because the forests were all burned
Because the land was under water

questions.text: What will the burial place given to Gog in Israel be called?
questions.explanation: They will bury Gog and all his multitude in the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea, and they will call it "The valley of Hamon Gog".

questions.text: For how long will the house of Israel be burying them, to cleanse the land?
questions.explanation: The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

questions.text: What will Hamonah be the name of?
questions.explanation: The text says that Hamonah will also be the name of a city, and thus they will cleanse the land.

questions.text: What are the birds and animals told they will eat and drink at the sacrifice?
questions.explanation: They are told they will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth.

answers.text: Only grain and oil from the fields
The flesh of the mighty and blood of princes
Bread and cups of new wine
The fat of the olive and the vine

questions.text: What does Yahweh say at the end that he has poured out on the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will no longer hide his face from them, for he has poured out his Spirit on the house of Israel.
